/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
sam='aln.primary.sam'
pairs=defaultdict(list)
for line in open(sam):
    if line.startswith('@'): continue
    f=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    q,flag,rname,pos,mapq,cigar=f[:6]
    flag=int(flag); mapq=int(mapq)
    if flag & 4: continue
    parts=rname.split('|')
    gene=parts[5] if len(parts)>5 else rname
    # primary only file but skip secondary/supp just in case
    if flag & 0x900: continue
    mate=1 if flag & 64 else 2 if flag & 128 else 0
    # get NM AS
    tags={x[:2]:x[5:] for x in f[11:] if len(x)>5 and x[2:5] in (':i:',':f:',':A:')}
    pairs[q].append((mate,gene,rname,int(pos),mapq,cigar,tags.get('NM'),tags.get('AS'),flag))

diff=Counter(); same=Counter(); incomplete=0; ambiguous=0; examples={}
for q,alns in pairs.items():
    # choose one per mate, minimap primary maybe exactly one each
    m={}
    for a in alns:
        m.setdefault(a[0],[]).append(a)
    if 1 not in m or 2 not in m:
        incomplete+=1; continue
    g1=m[1][0][1]; g2=m[2][0][1]
    if g1==g2:
        same[g1]+=1
    else:
        key=(g1,g2)
        diff[key]+=1
        examples.setdefault(key,(q,m[1][0],m[2][0]))
print('pairs with alignments',len(pairs),'incomplete',incomplete)
print('top diff')
for (g1,g2),c in diff.most_common(30):
    print(c,g1,g2,examples[(g1,g2)])
print('top same')
for g,c in same.most_common(10): print(c,g)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip
from collections import defaultdict
# parse alignments
pairs=defaultdict(list)
for line in open('aln.primary.sam'):
    if line.startswith('@'): continue
    f=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    flag=int(f[1])
    if flag & 4 or flag & 0x900: continue
    rname=f[2]; gene=rname.split('|')[5] if '|' in rname else rname
    mate=1 if flag & 64 else 2 if flag & 128 else 0
    tags={x[:2]:x[5:] for x in f[11:]}
    pairs[f[0]].append((mate,gene,rname,int(f[3]),int(f[4]),f[5],flag,tags.get('NM'),tags.get('AS')))
# original sequences
def readfq(path):
    with gzip.open(path,'rt') as fh:
        while True:
            h=fh.readline().strip()
            if not h: break
            s=fh.readline().strip(); fh.readline(); q=fh.readline().strip()
            yield h[1:],s,q
seqs={}
for h,s,q in readfq('gene.fusion.q1.R1.fq.gz'):
    seqs[(h,1)]=s
for h,s,q in readfq('gene.fusion.q1.R2.fq.gz'):
    seqs[(h,2)]=s
sel=[]
for q,alns in pairs.items():
    m={a[0]:a for a in alns if a[0] in (1,2)}
    if 1 in m and 2 in m and {m[1][1],m[2][1]}=={'GAPDH','SOX2'}:
        sel.append((q,m[1],m[2]))
print('selected',len(sel))
for item in sel[:50]:
    q,a1,a2=item
    print('\\n',q)
    print('R1',seqs[(q,1)],a1)
    print('R2',seqs[(q,2)],a2)
PY"
